item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Plot Leak Breakdown: All Your Biggest Questions About The Movie Answered - SPOILERS
item.description: A full Avengers: Doomsday plot leak has surfaced, and we're now breaking down all of its biggest reveals to bring you a definitive guide to what to expect from the upcoming movie.

item.title: FOR WORSE Interview: Missi Pyle Talks Possible Return For Long-Awaited GALAXY QUEST Sequel (Exclusive)
item.description: Talking to us about her role in For Worse, Missi Pyle confirms that she would be open to reprising her iconic role as Laliari in a long-awaited sequel to 1999 cult classic, Galaxy Quest.

item.title: TRANSFORMERS Star Shia LaBeouf Shares Fear Of "Big Gay People" In Tell-All Interview Before Second Arrest
item.description: Shia LaBeouf has been arrested for a second time in New Orleans, and recently sat down for a tell-all interview that saw him open up on his "small man complex" and fear of "big gay people."

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Rumor May Reveal New Details On Doctor Doom's "Right-Hand Man" - SPOILERS
item.description: You probably have a pretty good idea which character this is already, but just in case, we have some new details on Doctor Doom's right-hand man in Avengers: Doomsday...

item.title: THE MATRIX 5 Is Still In The Works Confirms PROJECT HAIL MARY's Drew Goddard
item.description: Nearly two years after it was announced as being in the works, filmmaker Drew Goddard has confirmed that he remains hard at work on the next instalment of The Matrix franchise.

item.title: SCREAM 7 Slashes Franchise Record With $64M Domestic Debut; $97M Worldwide
item.description: Scream 7 always looked set for a killer opening weekend at the box office, but the latest instalment in the long-running franchise has exceeded expectations with a $64M+ domestic debut...

item.title: BATMAN BEGINS Star Cillian Murphy Addresses Voldemort Casting Rumors In HARRY POTTER TV Series
item.description: After months of rumours and apparent confirmation from Ralph Fiennes, Cillian Murphy has set the record straight on claims he'll play Voldemort in HBO's Harry Potter TV series.
